items.title: Look past grey market hype, focus on fundamentals when applying for IPOs
items.description: Sebi has cautioned against relying on unofficial grey market premiums to gauge IPO listing gains, urging investors to assess subscription data, valuations and company fundamentals.

items.title: PhonePe warms up for IPO as investor appetite for Indian equities returns
items.description: The Walmart-owned fintech firm is expected to seek a listing valuation of ₹1.2 trillion to ₹1.5 trillion, with the timing of the IPO dependent on prevailing market conditions
